info.name: Adobe Lightroom List Assets in a Catalog

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: captured_after
params.description: Filter assets captured after this ISO 8601 timestamp

params.name: captured_before
params.description: Filter assets captured before this ISO 8601 timestamp

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of assets in the specified catalog. Supports filtering by subtype (image or video) and capture date range.

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

items.docs: Retrieves complete metadata for a specific asset including EXIF data, capture date, import source, location, develop settings, and links to available renditions.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Create or Update an Asset

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

items.docs: Creates a new asset or updates an existing asset in the catalog. The asset_id should be a client-generated UUID. After creating an asset, upload the master file using the master endpoint.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Upload the Original Master File

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

items.docs: Uploads the original (master) image or video file for a previously created asset. The Content-Type header must match the file type being uploaded. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, TIFF, DNG, and MP4.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Get Develop Settings Xmp

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

items.docs: Retrieves the external develop XMP sidecar data for the asset. Contains Lightroom develop module settings including exposure, white balance, tone curve, and other adjustments in XMP/RDF format.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Upload Develop Settings Xmp

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

items.docs: Uploads external develop XMP sidecar data for the asset. Applies Lightroom develop settings to the asset.

info.name: Adobe Lightroom Get an Asset Rendition

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the Lightroom catalog

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the asset (UUID format)

params.name: rendition_type
params.description: Rendition size type. thumbnail2x is a small thumbnail, numeric values indicate the longest edge in pixels, and fullsize is the maximum resolution available.

items.docs: Retrieves a server-generated rendition of the asset at the specified size. Renditions are JPEG preview images generated from the master file with current develop settings applied.
